001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Hourly Tandem Mobi record of six signed-byte statistics, probably of the BLE link's RSSI in dBm
009 * (values -95 to -18; not cross-checked against phone-side RSSI). In all 376 records from four
010 * pumps, {@link #getMinimum()} is the lowest and {@link #getMaximum()} the highest of the six,
011 * bytes 13-15 are non-decreasing multiples of 5 between them, and byte 12 lies between bytes 13
012 * and 15. Written at a fixed minute that differs between pumps.
013 *
014 * The class name is provisional: opcode 473 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
015 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
016 */
017@HistoryLogProps(
018    opCode = 473,
019    displayName = "BLE Link Stats"
020)
021public class BleLinkStatsHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
022
023    private int minimum;
024    private int maximum;
025    private int unknown12;
026    private int unknown13;
027    private int unknown14;
028    private int unknown15;
029    private int unknown16;
030    private int unknown18;
031    private int intervalSeconds;
032
033    public BleLinkStatsHistoryLog() {}
034    public BleLinkStatsHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int minimum, int maximum, int unknown12, int unknown13, int unknown14, int unknown15, int unknown16, int unknown18, int intervalSeconds) {
035        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
036        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, minimum, maximum, unknown12, unknown13, unknown14, unknown15, unknown16, unknown18, intervalSeconds);
037        this.minimum = minimum;
038        this.maximum = maximum;
039        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
040        this.unknown13 = unknown13;
041        this.unknown14 = unknown14;
042        this.unknown15 = unknown15;
043        this.unknown16 = unknown16;
044        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
045        this.intervalSeconds = intervalSeconds;
046    }
047
048    public int typeId() {
049        return 473;
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * <table border="1">
054     * <caption>Parsed fields for BleLinkStatsHistoryLog:</caption>
055     * <tr><td><code>minimum</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>maximum</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>unknown13</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknown14</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>unknown15</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>unknown16</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>intervalSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
064     * </table>
065     */
066    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
067        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
068        this.cargo = raw;
069        parseBase(raw);
070        this.minimum = raw[10];
071        this.maximum = raw[11];
072        this.unknown12 = raw[12];
073        this.unknown13 = raw[13];
074        this.unknown14 = raw[14];
075        this.unknown15 = raw[15];
076        this.unknown16 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
077        this.unknown18 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
078        this.intervalSeconds = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
079    }
080
081    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int minimum, int maximum, int unknown12, int unknown13, int unknown14, int unknown15, int unknown16, int unknown18, int intervalSeconds) {
082        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
083            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(473, 0),
084            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
085            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
086            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(minimum),
087            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(maximum),
088            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown12),
089            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown13),
090            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown14),
091            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown15),
092            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown16),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown18),
094            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(intervalSeconds)));
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * @return the lowest of the six signed statistics
099     */
100    public int getMinimum() {
101        return minimum;
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * @return the highest of the six signed statistics
106     */
107    public int getMaximum() {
108        return maximum;
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * Signed. Between {@link #getUnknown13()} and {@link #getUnknown15()}, and not quantized, so
113     * possibly a mean.
114     *
115     * @return raw int8 at offset 12
116     */
117    public int getUnknown12() {
118        return unknown12;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * Signed multiple of 5, &lt;= {@link #getUnknown14()}; possibly a percentile.
123     *
124     * @return raw int8 at offset 13
125     */
126    public int getUnknown13() {
127        return unknown13;
128    }
129
130    /**
131     * Signed multiple of 5, between {@link #getUnknown13()} and {@link #getUnknown15()}.
132     *
133     * @return raw int8 at offset 14
134     */
135    public int getUnknown14() {
136        return unknown14;
137    }
138
139    /**
140     * Signed multiple of 5, &gt;= {@link #getUnknown14()}.
141     *
142     * @return raw int8 at offset 15
143     */
144    public int getUnknown15() {
145        return unknown15;
146    }
147
148    /**
149     * 15-181 observed. Not the number of phone connections in the hour, and not correlated with the
150     * phone's message traffic.
151     *
152     * @return raw uint16 at offset 16
153     */
154    public int getUnknown16() {
155        return unknown16;
156    }
157
158    /**
159     * 311-5408 observed. Not the phone's connected seconds in the hour.
160     *
161     * @return raw uint16 at offset 18
162     */
163    public int getUnknown18() {
164        return unknown18;
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * 3599-3601 observed; equal to the pump-time gap to the previous record in 334 of 363
169     * hourly pairs and 1 second off in the other 29.
170     *
171     * @return the length of the period the record covers, in seconds
172     */
173    public int getIntervalSeconds() {
174        return intervalSeconds;
175    }
176}
